description: This is a shell script testing various behaviors of 'git reset' in bare and non-bare repositories, including success and failure scenarios for different reset modes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; runs a set of commands and checks for successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the provided command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files, exits with failure if they differ.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
